concept.literalSynthesis: A compact wand wrapped in the stitched panels of a vampire suit, with a dark ember glowing in its head. The tailored seams and blood-red spark bring together the stitched vampire costume and the vampire-spark wand.
concept.coreMechanic: Primary use casts one magic ember that travels toward the cursor, arcs downward under gravity, and heals its owner on a damaging hit. The shot keeps the wand parent's 12 base damage, 4-mana cost, and 26-tick reuse interval; healing is 10% of damage dealt, capped at 1 HP per hit. Equipping the same item grants 4 defense and +1 HP/s life regeneration. The passive defense and regeneration apply while equipped, never merely from holding the wand. The active shot is deliberately modest and single-hit, while its healing offers a small sustain benefit; mana is paid for each newly started use animation.
concept.parentAContribution: The vampire-spark wand supplies the visible ember-wand identity and the purposeful magic shot: a 12-damage, 4-mana cast with a gravity arc and a capped on-hit healing effect.
concept.parentBContribution: The stitched vampire costume supplies the sewn, wearable silhouette and the equipment role. Its regeneration inspires a passive benefit; the new item also grants explicitly authored defense while equipped.
concept.playerExperience: Click to cast a single arcing ember for 4 mana; a hit restores at most 1 HP. Equip it for 4 defense and +1 HP/s regeneration. Carrying or holding it alone grants no defense.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Cast a single magic ember toward the cursor. It deals 12 base damage, falls under gravity, costs 4 mana per newly started use animation, and restores up to 1 HP when it hits an NPC.
Wear the wand as an accessory for +4 defense and +1 HP/s life regeneration; the passive bonuses apply only while equipped.

realization.description: A stitched vampire wand that casts one red magic ember toward your cursor. Each shot costs 4 mana, deals 12 base damage, and bends downward as it flies. A damaging hit restores 10% of damage dealt, up to 1 HP. Equip the wand as an accessory for 4 defense and +1 HP/s regeneration; carrying it does not grant these bonuses.
realization.playerExperience: The wand combines a measured, single-hit ranged cast with a small capped heal. Its mana cost and reuse interval follow the cast, while its defensive and regenerative benefits require an accessory slot.
realization.selfEvaluation: The active cast and equipped passive are both explicit runtime behaviors. Damage, gravity, healing, defense, and regeneration are authored with catalog capabilities; no effect is inferred from the parents' names or category.
